name: oled_display_ssd1309
description: OLED SSD1309 display plugin for Volumio – shows playback info, clock, progress, audio format, and volume on a 128x64 I2C OLED
author: Zhapox

volumio_info.details: Drives a 128x64 SSD1309 I2C OLED display showing playback info, clock, progress bar, audio format, volume overlay, and screensaver. Designed for Raspberry Pi with zero MPD interference.
volumio_info.changelog: v1.7.29: Added Russian Cyrillic alphabet support (А–Я, а–я, Ё/ё). Fixed malformed audio info for Spotify/lossy streaming services where a bitrate in the samplerate field produced strings like '320kbpskHz' — now shows '320 Kbps'. v1.7.28: Plugin store reviewer feedback applied — slimmer install.sh, runtime I2C module load + display detection, standard v-conf config API.
